name: nakama-mcp
description: Talk to a Heroic Labs Nakama server — client (:7350) and console (:7351) APIs via search+execute plus convenience tools.
long_description: An MCP server for Heroic Labs Nakama. Exposes ~180 operations across the player-facing client API and the admin console API using a search+execute pattern, plus promoted tools for common jobs (player auth, storage, leaderboards, notifications, ban/unban, server status). Point it at any running Nakama instance.
